description: Qatar Consumption of Gas, Gasoline, Diesel and Jet Fuel Consumption is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Qatar Energy. The datasets provides: Total Daily average of domestic gas consumption within Qatar. LPG Consumption: Residential& Commercial LPG consumed within Qatar Gasoline domestic consumption: Gasoline consumed in Qatar for transportation in Kbbls per day Diesel domestic consumption: Quantity of Diesel consumed in Qatar for transportation Qatar in Kbbls per day Jet fuel Domestic consumption: Daily average ... Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Qatar Energy. Its tags are oil, gas, production, export, emissions. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
